game_1_1: The number shows a brick's health.
game_2_1: The balls icon shows how many you shoot.
game_2_2: The hit icon shows your base power.
game_3_1: Hold 3X to speed up the shot.
game_3_2: Tap recall to bring the balls back.
orbs_0_1: Your equipped Orbs go in the top slots.
orbs_0_2: Tap the slot you want to use.
orbs_1_1: Your Orbs are in the collection below.
orbs_1_2: Tap an Orb to select it.
orbs_2_1: Tap EQUIP to put it in the slot.
orbs_2_2: A green check means it is equipped.
orbs_remove_1: Its power is active while you play.
orbs_remove_2: Tap REMOVE to take it out of the slot.
orbs_3_1: Each Orb gives you a different power.
orbs_3_2: Tap DETAILS to see all its powers.
empty_0_1: Find Orbs in stages or in the Shop.
empty_0_2: Come back here to equip them.
empty_1_1: Open SHOP to see the Orb offers.
empty_1_2: Equip your Orbs in the Bag.
items_0_1: Tap an item's picture to select it.
items_0_2: The number shows how many you have.
items_1_1: Each picture stands for a different power.
items_2_1: Tap USE to activate the item.
items_2_2: One is used up when it activates.
items_3_1: Find more by playing or visiting the Shop.
items_3_2: Get ready for your next stage!
balls_0_1: Swipe or use arrows to browse balls.
balls_0_2: Use the rarity tabs to explore each tier.
balls_1_1: The balls icon shows your ball count.
balls_1_2: Tap a stat or strength pips for details.
balls_2_1: One arrow: shoot in a straight line.
balls_2_2: Spread arrows: shoot a wider burst.
balls_3_1: Tap the equip button to use this ball.
balls_3_2: A lock means you do not own it yet.
effect_crit_0: A chance to land a stronger hit.
effect_empower_0: A chance to make later hits stronger.
effect_explosive_0: A chance to blast nearby bricks.
effect_fetid_0: A chance to poison a brick over time.
effect_hammer_0: A chance to hammer a nearby brick.
effect_lightning_0: A chance to zap a nearby brick.
effect_luck_0: Earn more coins and find more loot.
effect_ready_0: Start the stage with more balls.
effect_secondw_0: Upgrade this Orb to unlock its rescue.
effect_sharp_0: Your ball hits deal more damage.
effect_split_0: A chance to hit extra bricks.
effect_reaper_0: A chance to land a powerful extra hit.
